name: NSFOCUS Technologies Group Co., Ltd.
summary: NSFOCUS Technologies Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides Internet and application security services in China and internationally. The company offers holistic, carrier-grade, and hybrid distributed denial of service (DDoS); and web security solutions.
